title_zh: 核对写作课程资格并完成报名

scenario.label_zh: 核对写作课程资格并完成报名
scenario.goal_zh: 根据课程说明确认资格，提交报名表并收到确认编号

context_zh: 美国社区学院的写作课程报名台上，申请者核对课程说明并操作报名网页。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Devon
sentences.text: I want to enroll in the evening writing course, but I have never studied literature.

sentences.speaker: Clerk Ames
sentences.text: That is fine. The course page says anyone eighteen or over is eligible; there is no prior-study requirement.

sentences.speaker: Devon
sentences.text: I am twenty-four. I have completed the form and read the course terms. Is this the final submit button?

sentences.speaker: Clerk Ames
sentences.text: Yes. Check that you selected the evening group before you submit.

sentences.speaker: Devon
sentences.text: The evening group is selected. I have submitted it now, and the screen shows confirmation W-218.

sentences.speaker: Clerk Ames
sentences.text: That means your registration was received. The confirmation lists your first session next Tuesday at six.

sentences.speaker: Devon
sentences.text: Great. I have saved it, and I will be here on Tuesday.
